findings: RMS is NOT uniform across classes (measured at SNR>=20): digital PSK/QAM/APSK/GMSK/OQPSK and AM-DSB/FM ~=1.0; OOK=1.47, 4ASK=1.75, 8ASK=1.91; AM-SSB-WC=11.74, AM-SSB-SC=7.83. Phase 2 generator MUST reproduce per-class RMS, not assume unit power.
RadioML2018.01A native sample rate is 200 kHz (official), but _frozen/configs/rml24_base.yaml signal.sample_rate=128000 (synthesis nominal). All Hz figures in this contract use 200 kHz.
sps=8 for digital modulations is confirmed by occupied_bw_99 ~= 0.125 = 1/8 (and official docs). The envelope-cyclostationarity sps estimate is unreliable for RRC alpha=0.35 and was discarded.
Occupied BW 99% is uniform 0.125 across PSK/QAM/APSK (=> RRC alpha~0.35); ASK ~0.107-0.115 (DC/carrier component); AM-SSB ~0.002 (carrier-dominated); DSB 0.064; FM 0.070; GMSK 0.119.
